description: PAID $0.005 USDC. Tokens bought/sold on Solana pump.fun and Base/BNB DEX swaps we observed, estimated cost basis and unrealized PnL only on those size-floored prints. Not a full explorer. Research only — not investment advice. Returns JSON tokens bought and sold in the observed prints, with estimated cost basis and unrealized PnL for those prints only.

address.description: Wallet seen in the meme prints. Format: 0x plus 40 hex characters, or a Solana public key. Example: 0x0000000000000000000000000000000000000000. Required.

api_key.description: Optional payment credential. Format: a prepaid key sk_scrapling_... or a catalog pass token sdp_... from pass_day or pass_month. Example: sdp_... . When omitted on a paid tool, the call is unpaid and the server answers with x402 PaymentRequired; retry the same call with the signed payment in params._meta['x402/payment'].

limit.description: Maximum tokens in the profile. Format: positive integer. Example: 20. Omit for the server's current cap.

name: meme_trader
